content: Obsidian 2026: official Web Clipper (Chrome/Firefox/Edge/Safari) with AI Interpreter prompts and templates, Bases (database views), backlinks/graph as long-established table stakes; community pattern claude-obsidian = self-organizing second brain via Claude Code over plain markdown (Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern).
